title: publication-bias-v1 player output
description: A single verdict per task: whether the meta-analytic set shows small-study / publication bias (funnel-plot asymmetry), with a confidence and optional supporting statistics.

bias_detected.description: True if the set shows small-study / publication bias (funnel asymmetry); false if it is symmetric / unbiased.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the bias_detected verdict.

egger_p.description: Optional. The Egger regression-test p-value the player computed, if any. Omit (do not send null) when not computed.

n_missing_trimfill.description: Optional. Number of studies trim-and-fill imputes as missing, if the player ran it. Omit when not computed.
